Add a Custom Deck.gl / External Layer Specification

Source: R/plugins.R
add_deck_layer.Rd

Allows R extension packages to dispatch arbitrary deck.gl or MapLibre custom layer specifications fed by GLMP binary buffers or JSON props.

Usage

add_deck_layer(
  map,
  deck_type,
  data = NULL,
  props = list(),
  id = NULL,
  group = NULL
)

Arguments

map

A glmap widget or glmap_proxy.

deck_type

Deck.gl layer class name (e.g., "ArcLayer", "ScatterplotLayer", "TripsLayer", "PathLayer").

data

Optional sf or data.frame packed into a binary buffer.

props

Named list of layer properties.

id

Layer ID.

group

Layer group name.
